title: Six IPOs, one unlock week: what happens when anchor investors can finally sell
short: Anchor lock-ins end for six IPOs. Will big investors sell?
dek: About ₹2,000 crore of anchor shares in six August listings become free to sell this week. SEBI's own research shows what anchors usually do next.
card: Technocraft is up 141%, LEAP India down 23%. Now their anchor investors can sell. Here's what the data says they usually do.
